title: Pimavanserin for Insomnia in Veterans With PTSD
official: Pimavanserin for Insomnia in Veterans With Post-traumatic Stress Disorder
summary: This is a preliminary randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing pimavanserin 34mg at bedtime vs. placebo for the treatment of insomnia associated with post-traumatic stress disorder.
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

sites.f: Michael E. DeBakey VA Medical Center, Houston, TX
